Click a point, frame or ring to edit its proposition and notes. Double-click empty canvas to add a point.

Select (V): drag empty canvas to select several objects. Drag selected objects to move them. Shift-click or Command-click adds to the selection.
Pan (H): drag to move the canvas. Hold Space for temporary pan; release to return to your current tool.
Two-finger scroll: pan. Pinch: zoom around the pointer. Command-scroll or the − / + buttons also zoom; click the percentage to return to 100%.
Actions: commands for the current selection or canvas. The ··· button beside Graphs opens graph/category commands. Secondary click and Control-click remain optional shortcuts.

Frames: drag a border to move, or the selected frame’s lower-right corner to resize. Choose “Move □ and contents” in Actions to carry its points with it.
Use the selection’s bottom buttons to create a frame, create a ring or delete.
Double-click a frame or ring to enter. Esc or the back button returns.
R: draw a frame. L: connect the selected object, then click its destination. Dragging a small connection handle also creates a relation.

Delete (⌫): delete selected objects. Command-Z: undo; Command-Shift-Z: redo.
Command-N: add a proposition. Command-S: save.
F / Command-0: fit all. Shift-F: fit for editing. Z: focus / return.
Shift-Space: show or hide titles. Arrow keys: select nearby points; double-tap to jump between frames. Enter: edit. Esc: return from text editing to the canvas.
